      • convertY14MapToYuyvPseudocolor

        public static int convertY14MapToYuyvPseudocolor(byte[] image_y14,
                                                 long pix_num,
                                                 CommonParams.PseudoColorType colorType,
                                                 byte[] out_yuv)
        设置伪彩，软件方式实现 Y14图像映射成YUYV伪彩模式【Y14 array map to YUV422 pseudocolor array】
        目前仅支持Y14模式【Currently only supports Y14 mode】
        参考固件机芯方式实现，see IRCMD.setPseudoColor(CommonParams.PreviewPathChannel, CommonParams.PseudoColorType)
        Parameters:
        image_y14 - source image frame with Y14 format
        pix_num - pixel number of whole frame
        colorType - pseudo color type during
        白热【White Hot】,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RESERVED,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_IRON_RED,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RAINBOW_1,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RAINBOW_2,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RAINBOW_3,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RED_HOT ,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_HOT_RED,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RAINBOW_4 ,
        CommonParams.PseudoColorType#PSEUDO_RAINBOW_5,
        黑热【Black Hot】,
        白热 White_Hot,
        黑热 Black_Hot,
        彩虹 Rainbow,
        铁红 Ironbow,
        极光 Aurora,
        丛林 Jungle,
        金红 Glory_Hot,
        医疗 Medical,
        微光 Night,
        辉金 Sepia,
        红热 Red_Hot,
        out_yuv - [out] destination frame after pseudo color mapping
        Returns:
        see LibIRProcess.IrporcResult
